row._comment: Was nested under `grids.row` — the pipeline emitted --origam-grids__row---* while OrigamRow.vue reads --origam-row---* under its own name (issue #417 / #508). Split into its own top-level file so the emitted prefix matches the component. padding-block-*/padding-inline-* are NEW here: OrigamRow.vue's SCSS read --origam-container---padding-* by mistake (issue #405, 'sans repli' — a copy-paste leftover, every other declaration in the same file correctly reads --origam-row---*) with no channel of its own; values below match Row's pre-existing local :root fallback (0), so the visual default is unchanged.

border._comment: Same mechanism as container.$state.border — see there.
